items.title: Write audited execution plan for signed workspace resolution
items.context: Document the correctness boundary after B-3787: currentReviewRound diagnostics are fixed, but metadataRoot != signed git workspace root still blocks review_run_start. The plan must be host-neutral, support CLI Non-authority and Authority Server paths, avoid arbitrary optimization, and follow consistency of logic.
items.userSees: User sees "Executable plan written: review-run-start-signed-workspace-resolution-execution-plan.md; two-host drafts reconciled; final Claude host review completed."

happy.desc: The new execution document defines the metadataRoot versus signedWorkspaceRoot correctness issue and gives concrete implementation phases for explicit binding/configuration, fail-closed diagnostics, tests, and rollout.
The document records that Claude CLI and Codex CLI host perspectives were used as local non-authority audit inputs and reconciled by the main auditor.

edge.desc: The document preserves direct REVIEW compatibility for normal git-backed project roots and does not require a worktree for every REVIEW story.
The plan explicitly rejects automatic nested-repo guessing and requires explicit gitRoot configuration or story worktree attachment when metadata root is non-git.

adversarial.desc: The document separates localNonAuthorityAudit from authorityServerPath and forbids claiming receiptVerified, productionDone, authorityDone, or fullAuthorityDone from host prose or local reviewer runs.
The regression matrix includes fail-closed cases for non-git wrapper root, missing worktree binding, ambiguous nested repos, stale/mismatched hashes, and forged/local-only Authority evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Document defines the root mismatch issue, implementation phases, and regression matrix for explicit signed workspace resolution.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "localNonAuthorityAudit|Codex CLI|Claude CLI|Main Auditor Reconciliation|Final Claude CLI Review Record" docs/requirements/decisions/review-run-start-signed-workspace-resolution-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document records the two host perspectives, main auditor reconciliation, and final Claude CLI PASS as local non-authority audit only.

verificationEvidence.note: Document preserves direct REVIEW compatibility for normal git-backed project roots and does not require a worktree for every REVIEW story.
Document rejects arbitrary nested repo discovery and requires explicit gitRoot or story worktree attachment for non-git metadata roots.
Document separates localNonAuthorityAudit from authorityServerPath and forbids Authority completion claims from host prose or local reviewer runs.
